title: MeshSync Geometry Extension
description: Geometry analysis metadata for 3D model files

v1.description: Version 1 of the geometry extension schema

vertex_count.description: Number of vertices in the mesh

face_count.description: Number of faces in the mesh

edge_count.description: Number of edges in the mesh

triangle_count.description: Number of triangles (may differ from face_count for quads/ngons)

is_manifold.description: Whether the mesh is manifold (each edge shared by exactly 2 faces)

is_watertight.description: Whether the mesh is watertight (closed, no holes)

has_normals.description: Whether vertex or face normals are present

has_uvs.description: Whether UV texture coordinates are present

volume_mm3.description: Volume in mm³ (negative if inverted normals)
